name: dobe_hold_key
desc: Make the huge pink paint goo Doberman put the small black witch cat in a full nelson from behind: it hunches down over the cat, slides both thick goo arms under the cat's armpits from behind and clasps its hands together behind the cat's neck, lifting the cat a little so its feet dangle above the puddle. Its arms and chest smear sticky pink paint over the cat. The cat is in front of the monster, struggling in distress: arms forced up, eyes squeezed, mouth open, legs kicking. The Doberman leans its head beside the cat with a sly smirk and stern yellow eyes. Keep the same Doberman design, colors, marble, puddle base with no legs, the same cat design and size, and the same pixel art style. Transparent background.
